fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck entry off Distribution Ct at the SE corner; full chain-link perimeter fence confirmed on all sides via Street View (2007 + 2024 panos) and satellite.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small booth-footprint structure beside the SE entry lane visible at z20-21 satellite; consistent with a staffed gatehouse but not crisply resolved, so flagged.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Single very long south-facing dock bank running the length of a 1.1M sq ft building plus the east-end face; well over 50 doors (est ~110).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large fenced drop yard south of the dock apron with many rows of parked trailers; 50+ band, est capacity ~220.
fieldNotes.scale: No clearly identifiable truck scale pad resolved; left false.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main 1.1M sq ft DC plus a separate small satellite/fleet building in the SW yard.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and ample paved width at the SE entry leave room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Oconomowoc, surrounded by farmland and a light industrial park; Rural per rubric.
